I was exploring Redwood after signing up for the Hosted API sandbox this morning (love the docs!). Our team at CleverTail is evaluating embeddings + generation for personalization and we’d like a short walkthrough of the Hosted API and sandbox capabilities — 30 minutes ideally. We’re in PDT (UTC-7) and available tomorrow or Thursday morning; happy to do late afternoon as well.

- Can you confirm the sandbox includes streaming responses?

1) Tue 4/19, 10:00–10:30 AM
2) Tue 4/19, 3:30–4:00 PM
3) Thu 4/21, 9:00–9:30 AM

If you prefer a slightly deeper session we can do 45 minutes instead — we usually do 30 for PLG intake. The sandbox does support streaming responses and you can toggle streaming in the UI or via the API. We’ll provision an ephemeral sandbox workspace for your account with a sample prompt set.

Attached is a very short pre-demo checklist (hostedapi-pre-demo-checklist.pdf) — if you can complete items 1–3 before the call we’ll get straight into latency/cost numbers and a short live test.

If none of those work, tell me a window and I’ll coordinate. I’ve cc’d Diego (SDR ops) to help with calendar invites and Marissa (PLG ops) for sandbox provisioning.

Best,
